gaps.sentence: Scarcely had the plane taken ___ when the alarm sounded.
gaps.explanation: 'Taken off' completes the phrasal verb inside the inverted 'scarcely had … when' structure.

gaps.sentence: In no way ___ this decision reflect the views of the board.
gaps.explanation: 'In no way does this decision reflect …' — auxiliary 'does' + base verb.

gaps.sentence: Only after the third reminder ___ she reply to my email.
gaps.explanation: 'Only after' fronts the condition, so 'did she reply' inverts.

gaps.sentence: Only later ___ it occur to her that the letter had been a forgery.
gaps.explanation: 'Only later' at the front inverts with do-support: did it occur to her.

gaps.sentence: Hardly ___ anyone noticed the subtle change in the final scene.
So widespread ___ the outage that servers abroad noticed.
gaps.explanation: So widespread was the outage that… — inversion.

gaps.sentence: Hardly ___ the tenders been opened when the leak was traced to the press office.
gaps.explanation: 'Hardly had … been opened when' — past perfect passive with inversion.

gaps.sentence: Such ___ the demand for tickets that the website crashed.
gaps.explanation: Such was the demand that… — emphatic result structure.
